description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Rear Axle Housing PLUS the Rear Axle Bearing and Oil Seal Repair Kit.
It does BOTH SIDES.
You get everything you need to complete the repair on both axles.
Contains Genuine Suzuki OEM Parts & Quality After-market Parts
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Rear Axle Housing
Qty 2 – Bearings (LH & RH)
Qty 2 – Oil Seals (LH & RH)
Qty 2 – Retainer Ring, Oil Seals (LH & RH)
Qty 2 – Protectors, Oil Seals (LH & RH)
Qty 8 – Stud Bolts
Qty 1 – Breather Cap Assembly
Qty 1 – Filler Plug
Qty 1 – Drain Plug & Gasket
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
